auditRunner.correctionFromBuildRunner: Require save, factory-reset, and post-reset save operators each to return FINISHED; this tightens acceptance before the first F0 app launch.

auditSequence: Run the injected official-config collision negative control and require zero Blender process starts.
Freshly admit and launch F0 in background with no BLENDER_USER_* overrides.
Resolve all user roots, toggle one benign preference, save, load factory preferences, save again, and require each operator to finish.
Hash official Blender configuration state and require it to remain identical.
Freshly admit and launch the GUI F0 app, capture the actual startup splash from the app framebuffer, and quit.
Hash official Blender configuration state again and inspect bundle, icon, splash, topbar identity, runtime product line, and source commit.
stopRule: Any failed admission starts zero F0 processes. Any failed operator, path, hash, identity, screenshot, or negative-control check produces FAIL rather than relaxing acceptance.
